verdict.rationale: Resend documents a dedicated batch endpoint, `POST https://api.resend.com/emails/batch`, that sends up to 100 emails in one request, which replaces looping one call per recipient. The evidence does not show what the batch response contains or confirm per-message personalization, so those parts of the story are only implied. Missing for 10: documentation of per-message status/IDs in the batch response, explicit per-message personalization fields, independent or hands-on corroboration of batch sending.
